## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

# Discovery inspired by plants

Advancing plant and molecular science for a sustainable future.

[Image link]

## We're on a mission

To advance, communicate, and leverage pioneering discoveries in plant sciences to develop
sustainable and resilient agriculture, improve food security, protect the environment, and enhance
human health.

[Learn More][65]
[Image link]

## Three pillars of impact

For over a century, our vision has been simple yet powerful: discover how biology works at its most
fundamental level, and use that knowledge to improve agriculture, human health, and the environment.

[Ripe red cherry tomatoes growing on a sunlit garden vine at Boyce Thompson Institute, showcasing
advanced plant research and sustainable agriculture techniques.]

### Research

Discovery inspired by plants

[Learn More][66]
[Overhead shot of tractor in a field]

### Translational Science

Discoveries making an impact

[Learn More][67]
[Scientists and students examining plant growth in a greenhouse at Boyce Thompson Institute for
plant research and biotechnology.]

### Education

Inspiring the next generation

[Learn More][68]
[Image link]

### Every day, you interact with the work of plant scientists and never know it.

The food on your table. The aspirin in your medicine cabinet. The vaccine that prevents cervical
cancer. The cotton in your clothing. Behind each of these is a chain of discovery that began with a
simple question about how plants work — and in many cases, that question was first asked at the
Boyce Thompson Institute.
[Learn More][69]

# Discovery inspired by plants

Advancing plant and molecular science for a sustainable future.

[Image link]

## We're on a mission

To advance, communicate, and leverage pioneering discoveries in plant sciences to develop
sustainable and resilient agriculture, improve food security, protect the environment, and enhance
human health.

[Learn More][65]
[Image link]

## Three pillars of impact

For over a century, our vision has been simple yet powerful: discover how biology works at its most
fundamental level, and use that knowledge to improve agriculture, human health, and the environment.

[Ripe red cherry tomatoes growing on a sunlit garden vine at Boyce Thompson Institute, showcasing
advanced plant research and sustainable agriculture techniques.]

### Research

Discovery inspired by plants

[Learn More][66]
[Overhead shot of tractor in a field]

### Translational Science

Discoveries making an impact

[Learn More][67]
[Scientists and students examining plant growth in a greenhouse at Boyce Thompson Institute for
plant research and biotechnology.]

### Education

Inspiring the next generation

[Learn More][68]
[Image link]

### Every day, you interact with the work of plant scientists and never know it.

The food on your table. The aspirin in your medicine cabinet. The vaccine that prevents cervical
cancer. The cotton in your clothing. Behind each of these is a chain of discovery that began with a
simple question about how plants work — and in many cases, that question was first asked at the
Boyce Thompson Institute.
[Learn More][69]

## CFX Sports Issue

### In this issue:

Hundreds of sports media, marketing and technology executives gathered in New York City on June 4
for the 2026 Cynopsis Sports Awards & Top Women in Sports Gala, celebrating the people,
organizations and innovations shaping the future of sports media.

The evening honored excellence across content, distribution, fan engagement, brand strategy, data,
technology and executive leadership, while recognizing an extraordinary class of Top Women in Sports
honorees driving innovation across the industry.

To further celebrate this year’s winners and honorees, sister publication CFX dedicated its June
Sports Issue to the leaders, teams and innovations breaking down barriers between fans and the
sports they love. The issue features exclusive Luminary profiles of NBCUniversal, the Professional
Women’s Hockey League (PWHL) and Stanley 1913, along with a special Top Women in Sports feature
spotlighting the executives reshaping media rights, sponsorships and storytelling across the sports
ecosystem.

Explore the winners and honorees below, or read the full CFX Sports Issue to learn how they’re
changing the game for fans, brands and the future of sports media.

## CFX Sports Issue

### In this issue:

Hundreds of sports media, marketing and technology executives gathered in New York City on June 4
for the 2026 Cynopsis Sports Awards & Top Women in Sports Gala, celebrating the people,
organizations and innovations shaping the future of sports media.

The evening honored excellence across content, distribution, fan engagement, brand strategy, data,
technology and executive leadership, while recognizing an extraordinary class of Top Women in Sports
honorees driving innovation across the industry.

To further celebrate this year’s winners and honorees, sister publication CFX dedicated its June
Sports Issue to the leaders, teams and innovations breaking down barriers between fans and the
sports they love. The issue features exclusive Luminary profiles of NBCUniversal, the Professional
Women’s Hockey League (PWHL) and Stanley 1913, along with a special Top Women in Sports feature
spotlighting the executives reshaping media rights, sponsorships and storytelling across the sports
ecosystem.

Explore the winners and honorees below, or read the full CFX Sports Issue to learn how they’re
changing the game for fans, brands and the future of sports media.

# Custom Web & App Development

## Austin, TX

We build the software your business runs on. Apps, websites, integrations, and automations from a
team that sticks around after launch.

[ Let's Talk ][32]

## Apps & Websites

Custom web and mobile applications built from the ground up. Websites designed to convert. From
planning and design through development and launch.

## Automations & AI

Connect your tools, eliminate manual processes, and put AI to work. Practical automations that save
your team hours every week.

## Marketing Systems

CRM setup, email automation, analytics, and integrations. We handle the technical side of your
marketing stack so your marketing team can focus on strategy.

## Trusted by Teams Building Real Products

We’ve partnered with startups and established organizations to design, build, and support apps and
websites across a wide range of industries.

[spl-logo]
[EpisodeSix_NEWLogo1]

## Featured Projects

A selection of real-world projects where we helped teams plan, build, and launch apps and websites.

[pexels-pixabay-289737]

### Lightspeed Systems

Redesigned a K-12 ed-tech platform to improve navigation and page performance, resulting in a

specifically for Amiga computers equipped with Emu68 and PiStorm, PiStorm16, PiStorm32 acceleration
hardware.

[Download CaffeineOS Now][1]

## Experience Enhanced Amiga Performance
* Optimized specifically for PiStorm, PiStorm16, PiStorm32 and Emu68
* Plug-and-play installation with minimal configuration required
* Significantly improved performance over standard Amiga OS
* 99% compatible with your favorite Amiga applications and games
* Regular updates and community support
* It is 100% free of charge!

CaffeineOS requires an Amiga computer equipped with either PiStorm, PiStorm16, PiStorm32 and Emu68.
Compatible with Amiga 500, 600, 1200 and 2000 models.

Download the package and follow the step-by-step installation guide included in the download. The
typical installation process takes less than 15 minutes.

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for

widely used ingredient in the chemical industry, known for its ability to retain moisture and
maintain hydration in various formulations. Produced from both plant and animal sources, glycerine
is a clear, odorless, and non-toxic liquid that holds a significant place in the beauty,
pharmaceutical, and cosmetic sectors. Glycerine Manufacturers focus on producing high-quality, pure
glycerine that meets strict industry standards. The product’s adaptability is a major advantage for
manufacturers involved in custom chemical manufacturing, where consistent performance and purity are
critical.

Top Product

# Soda Ash

## ELRASA^{TM} – SAL

Two industries dominate global soda ash demand: glass manufacturing and detergents. They use the
same chemical compound, sodium carbonate, but in physically different forms. Glass plants need dense
soda ash for the free-flowing batch handling their furnaces require. Detergent makers need light
soda ash that dissolves rapidly into formulation. Buying the wrong grade creates real operational
problems downstream, which is why grade selection is the first procurement decision soda ash buyers
actually make. Elchemy supplies ELRASA™-SAL Soda Ash in both dense and light grades to industrial
buyers across 40+ countries, with quality matched to glass-grade, detergent-grade, and
chemical-processing-grade specifications. Domestic stock is also held at our US warehouses for
faster fulfillment.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

# Growjo

# revenue, competitor/alternative analysis, “number of employees” growth, funding news, sales &

# Top 10,000 companies for the Spring of 2026. Because this list is focused on startups with
# traction, to qualify the company must have between 15 and 1,000 employees. In addition to the
# exportable list below, you can check our contact data for these companies that includes email
# addresses and direct phone numbers. Within the pages you will find quality alternatives to the

# Pioneer in
# Alkaloid Research

INGA is the world’s leading manufacturer of natural extracts and standardized extracts since the
last 5 decades. We utilize our knowledge and R&D expertise to provide incomparable products to our
customers across the world.

[Click to know more about our Products.][21]

[Alkaloids][22][Phytochemicals][23][Extracts][24]
[Dr. Abraham Patan]

## FOUNDER

Dr. Abraham Patani, born in Kerala, found his passion for science at an early age. This led him to
complete his Bachelors in Pharmacy at Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, India.

In his quest to pursue research, he travelled to Germany and completed his Doctorate of Science in
Phytochemistry at The University of Mainz in 1958. He published his scientific research in the field
of Thin Layer Chromatography in reputed journals, which earned him great admiration across the
world.


After completion of his Doctoral Studies, he came back to India and established Indo - German
Alkaloids - the parent company of the Inga Group. Dr Abraham Patani is a founding member and past
president of the Indian Drug Manufacturers’ Association.

## History

## History

[Indo German Alkaloids]
**1958:** Indo German Alkaloids, the parent company of the Inga Group was established in 1958 to
manufacture phytochemicals and plant extracts that were not manufactured in the country
[The Headquarters of the Inga Group]
**1971:** The Headquarters of the Inga Group was built in 1971 at Andheri in Mumbai.
[Inga Laboratories P. Ltd]
**1974:** Inga Laboratories P. Ltd. was established in 1974 to manufacture pharmaceutical
formulations of alkaloids
[Inga Pharmaceuticals Manufacturing Unit]
**2008:** To cater to the additional demand, the Inga Pharmaceuticals manufacturing unit in Chennai
was established in 2008

## Company Overview

## Company Overview

Inga Pharmaceuticals is a leading manufacturer and supplier of pharmaceutical-grade [alkaloids][25],
Phytochemicals, herbal extracts and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India. With decades
of expertise in phytochemistry and botanical extraction, the company offers a wide portfolio of
high-quality products including [Belladonna Leaf Dry Extract][26], [Belladonna Total alkaloids][27],
[Belladonna Tincture][28], Thick Belladonna Extract, [Berberine Chloride][29], [Berberine
Tannate][30], [Caffeine][31], [Citrated Caffeine][32], [Colchicine][33], [Noscapine][34],
[Papaverine Hydrochloride][35], Quinine Hydrochloride, [Methoxsalen][36], [Podophyllotoxin][37]
Sennosides, [Capsicum Oleoresin][38], [Podophyllum Resin][39], [Ivy Leaf Dry Extract][40],
[Liquorice Liquid Extract][41], [Thyme Extract][42] and [Ipecacuanha Liquid Extract][43]. Inga
Pharmaceuticals manufactures these products using advanced extraction and quality control processes
to meet global pharmaceutical industry standards.

Inga Pharmaceuticals supplies pharmaceutical manufacturers and healthcare brands with premium-grade
ingredients such as Noscapine [Hydrochloride Hydrate][44], Ammonium Glycyrrhizinate, [Capsicum
Oleoresin][45] and standardized botanical [extracts][46] for a wide range of therapeutic and
formulation applications.

Known for innovation, research-driven manufacturing and long-standing industry experience, Inga
Pharmaceuticals continues to expand its portfolio of natural extracts, [alkaloids][47] and
Phytochemicals ingredients for global pharmaceutical and wellness markets. The company also offers
custom manufacturing, process development and formulation support for pharmaceutical and herbal
product applications. Inga Pharmaceuticals serves as a reliable manufacturer and supplier committed
to quality, consistency and customer satisfaction for Caffeine, Belladonna Derivatives,
[Podophyllotoxin][48], [Methoxsalen][49], [Ivy Leaf Dry Extract][50] or [Liquorice Liquid
Extract][51].

Phytochemicals, herbal extracts and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in India. With decades
of expertise in phytochemistry and botanical extraction, the company offers a wide portfolio of
high-quality products including [Belladonna Leaf Dry Extract][26], [Belladonna Total alkaloids][27],
[Belladonna Tincture][28], Thick Belladonna Extract, [Berberine Chloride][29], [Berberine
Tannate][30], [Caffeine][31], [Citrated Caffeine][32], [Colchicine][33], [Noscapine][34],
[Papaverine Hydrochloride][35], Quinine Hydrochloride, [Methoxsalen][36], [Podophyllotoxin][37]
Sennosides, [Capsicum Oleoresin][38], [Podophyllum Resin][39], [Ivy Leaf Dry Extract][40],
[Liquorice Liquid Extract][41], [Thyme Extract][42] and [Ipecacuanha Liquid Extract][43]. Inga
Pharmaceuticals manufactures these products using advanced extraction and quality control processes
to meet global pharmaceutical industry standards.

Inga Pharmaceuticals supplies pharmaceutical manufacturers and healthcare brands with premium-grade
ingredients such as Noscapine [Hydrochloride Hydrate][44], Ammonium Glycyrrhizinate, [Capsicum
Oleoresin][45] and standardized botanical [extracts][46] for a wide range of therapeutic and
formulation applications.

Known for innovation, research-driven manufacturing and long-standing industry experience, Inga
Pharmaceuticals continues to expand its portfolio of natural extracts, [alkaloids][47] and
Phytochemicals ingredients for global pharmaceutical and wellness markets. The company also offers
custom manufacturing, process development and formulation support for pharmaceutical and herbal
product applications. Inga Pharmaceuticals serves as a reliable manufacturer and supplier committed
to quality, consistency and customer satisfaction for Caffeine, Belladonna Derivatives,
[Podophyllotoxin][48], [Methoxsalen][49], [Ivy Leaf Dry Extract][50] or [Liquorice Liquid
Extract][51].

in the province.

We support various supplementary forms including capsules, gummies, tablets, and liquids.

supplements.

guidance, problem-solving, and process simplification while leveraging our extensive manufacturing
capabilities.

printing, and more.

blister packs etc.

Competitive pricing based on long-term partnerships helps clients build trusted brands that
consumers rely on continuously.

[frequently asked questions]
How do we handle ethical and confidentiality concerns?

Ethical considerations and confidentiality are at the core of our operations. We ensure that all our
applications are developed and used in accordance with ethical standards and respect for patient
confidentiality. We are committed to transparent practices that safeguard user and patient data,
upholding the highest ethical norms in all our processes.

What security measures are in place for user data?

We prioritize the security of user data with multiple layers of protection, including encryption,
secure data storage solutions, and regular security audits. Our applications comply with all
relevant data protection regulations, such as GDPR and HIPAA, to ensure that your information is
handled securely and with the utmost care.

How can our solutions help poison control centers?

Our solutions are tailored to enhance the operational efficiency of poison control centers. Tools
like our voice recognition systems help manage long conversations effectively, while our diagnostic
and management applications provide quick access to crucial information, reducing response times and
improving case handling.

How can I get more information or a demonstration of your products?

To learn more about our products or to request a demonstration, please contact our sales and support
team through the website's contact form, or by calling our customer service hotline provided on the
contact page.

Are these applications compatible with mobile devices?

Yes, many of our applications are designed to be compatible with both Android and iOS devices,
allowing for convenient mobile use. This compatibility ensures that healthcare professionals can
access crucial tools and information directly from their smartphones or tablets, facilitating better
on-site decision-making.

Do you offer technical support for your applications?

Yes, we offer comprehensive technical support for all our applications. Our dedicated support team
is available to assist with any issues or questions you might have, ensuring that your experience
with our products is smooth and efficient. You can reach our support team via email, phone, or
through a live chat feature on our website.

Are there any system requirements for running these applications?

The system requirements for our applications vary depending on the specific tool and its
functionality. Generally, a modern web browser and a stable internet connection are sufficient for
online applications.

Credentials
[quote]

Caffeine may be used to impart a bitter taste to some food and beverage products, and some products
may also contain caffeine for its well-known pick-me-up qualities. Caffeine is required to be listed
in the ingredients list on food and beverage product labels, and some manufacturers also choose to
list the quantity of caffeine on product labels as well.

Caffeine qualifies as a GRAS ingredient as it fulfills the criteria for it i.e. the GRAS ingredient
must meet one of the following requirements:
The ingredient’s safety was established before 1958, based on a history of safe use and consumption
by a significant number of consumers.
Scientific data and information about the safety and use of ingredient is widely known and publicaly
available(through scientific articles, etc.), and there is consensus among scientific experts that
the ingredient is safe for its intended use.

Green Coffee Bean extract is definitely the most important among the recent discoveries in the
sphere of dietology. The combination of caffeine and chlorogenic acid makes the most powerful
natural fat burner. A convenient use form, the exact in capsules, allows you to take this supplement
no matter where you are. Chlorogenic acid working with the natural caffeine work together to help
the person reduce weight and diminish the look of cellulite. It is known to boost metabolism.

The specific cognitive theory, championed by H.Nash in his 1962 book “Alcohol and Caffeine”, asserts
that caffeine acts directly on “specific neural capacities” that are intrinsic to a given task and
that it enhances performance on these tasks irrespective of whether a person is fatigued. This idea
was suggested to Nash by his examination of performances of several different short-term tasks, some
of which exhibited improvement after caffeine was ingested, while others remain unaffected.

Credentials
[quote]

Caffeine may be used to impart a bitter taste to some food and beverage products, and some products
may also contain caffeine for its well-known pick-me-up qualities. Caffeine is required to be listed
in the ingredients list on food and beverage product labels, and some manufacturers also choose to
list the quantity of caffeine on product labels as well.

Caffeine qualifies as a GRAS ingredient as it fulfills the criteria for it i.e. the GRAS ingredient
must meet one of the following requirements:
The ingredient’s safety was established before 1958, based on a history of safe use and consumption
by a significant number of consumers.
Scientific data and information about the safety and use of ingredient is widely known and publicaly
available(through scientific articles, etc.), and there is consensus among scientific experts that
the ingredient is safe for its intended use.

Green Coffee Bean extract is definitely the most important among the recent discoveries in the
sphere of dietology. The combination of caffeine and chlorogenic acid makes the most powerful
natural fat burner. A convenient use form, the exact in capsules, allows you to take this supplement
no matter where you are. Chlorogenic acid working with the natural caffeine work together to help
the person reduce weight and diminish the look of cellulite. It is known to boost metabolism.

The specific cognitive theory, championed by H.Nash in his 1962 book “Alcohol and Caffeine”, asserts
that caffeine acts directly on “specific neural capacities” that are intrinsic to a given task and
that it enhances performance on these tasks irrespective of whether a person is fatigued. This idea
was suggested to Nash by his examination of performances of several different short-term tasks, some
of which exhibited improvement after caffeine was ingested, while others remain unaffected.

## What is nuCaffeine?

nuCaffeine is a liquid caffeine concentrate that you can add to any beverage to make your own energy
drinks at home.

The idea for nuCaffeine started after David, Co-Founder and President, began feeling unwell from
drinking too many energy drinks. The added sugars and chemicals were taking a toll on his body and
health.

nuCaffeine liquid caffeine concentrate was the solution for getting a caffeine kick without
compromising your health or taste. Made from 100% natural caffeine from coffee beans, nuCaffeine
contains zero sugars, sweeteners, toxic additives, or artificial preservatives.

[nuCaffeine bitter blocker ingredients scene]

## Our Bitter Blocker Formula

nuCaffeine uses powerful plant-derived bitter blockers that mask the bitter taste of caffeine. Our
bitter blockers block almost all bitterness receptors activated by caffeine. Our customer
satisfaction reports show that less than 1% of our customers taste any form of bitterness after
mixing nuCaffeine with their favorite drink.

Because our bitter-blocker formula is plant-derived, we can continue to offer a vegan, natural,
non-GMO and clean product.

Yeah, We Keep It 100%

**We're 100% Natural.**

Down to the preservatives. No GMOs, chemicals, or artificial flavors.

**We're 100% Vegan.**

Everything inside our bottle comes straight from plants. Good for you. Good for the planet.

**You have 100% Control.**

You choose what goes in your body. From the caffeine to the flavor and the sugar (if you want it!).
With nuCaffeine, your energy drinks are *100% customizable.*

Our production facilities are **FDA-registered** for pharmaceutical manufacturing and fully

## WHAT WE DO BEST

## NICOTINE POUCHES

Launch your own line of high-quality **nicotine pouches** with full control over strength, flavor,
format, and packaging. All products are manufactured in FDA-registered, GMP- and ISO-certified
facilities to meet the highest global standards.

[

NICOTINE POUCHES 

][43]

## CAFFEINE & ENERGY POUCHES

Infused with powerful stimulants like **synthetic caffeine** or natural guarana, our energy pouches
deliver a quick, clean boost — without sugar or calories. Perfect for active, on-the-go consumers
seeking sharp focus or enhanced performance. We can make up to 200mg of caffeine per pouch.

CAFFEINE POUCHES

## NOOTROPIC POUCHES

Enhance focus, clarity, and mental performance with our expertly formulated **nootropic pouches**.
We use clinically backed ingredients like L-theanine, Alpha-GPC, Rhodiola, and more — all
customizable to your desired effects.

[

NOOTROPIC POUCHES

][45]

## NICOTINE BREAKER POUCHES

Offer an innovative experience with our **breaker pouch technology**, featuring a flavor capsule
inside the nicotine pouch. Combine dual flavors or added cooling effects to create a distinctive,
interactive product.

Where are your factory located?

Our production facilities are located in **Sweden** & **Asia**, strategically positioned for global
distribution across Europe, North America, and the Middle East.

We offer fast lead times and high-capacity manufacturing for nicotine, caffeine, and nootropic
pouches.

What formulations for nootropic pouches do you offer?

We offer a wide range of **custom nootropic formulations**, including:

– Focus blends
– Energy blends
– Calm/relaxation formulas
– Memory & cognitive performance blends
– Mushroom extract blends (lion’s mane, cordyceps, chaga)
– Adaptogen blends
 

We can also develop **fully custom formulations** based on your target effect profile.

Are your product legal in EU?

Yes. Our nicotine alternatives, caffeine pouches, and nootropic pouches can be formulated to meet
**EU regulations**, including rules for non-tobacco oral products. We also support compliance
documentation.

Are your products legal in the U.S?

We manufacture both **US** & **EU-compliant formulations** and **international versions**, depending
on your target market. Regulations vary by country, and we help guide you through the compliance
process.

Whats your MOQ?

Our MOQ starts from 2,500 cans in China, and 5040 cans in Sweden. Depending on the formulation,
pouch format, and packaging requirements. We also offer pilot runs for new brands.

How can i manufacture nicotine pouches?

We provide **complete contract manufacturing**, including formulation, flavor development, pouch
production, filling, packaging, and quality control. You only need your brand concept—our team
handles the rest.

What kind of Caffeine pouches do you offer?

We offer custom **energy pouches**, including caffeine-only, caffeine + taurine, natural energy
blends, B-vitamin blends, and green tea/guarana–based formulas. Strengths and flavors are fully
customizable.

What is your production capacity per month?

Our factory can manufacture 50 million per month in China, and 5 million per month in Sweden.
Depending on product type. We scale production based on your growth and long-term forecasting.

How much does your products costs?

Pricing depends on formulation, active ingredients, pouch type, packaging, and order size. We
provide transparent, competitive quotes tailored to your brand’s specifications.

Can i make custom strength for nicotine pouches?

Yes — we offer **fully customizable strengths**, including nicotine, synthetic nicotine, 6-methyl
analog, caffeine, or nootropics. You can choose strengths tailored to your market and regulatory
needs.

Have questions? We’re here to help

Where are your factory located?

Our production facilities are located in **Sweden** & **Asia**, strategically positioned for global
distribution across Europe, North America, and the Middle East.

We offer fast lead times and high-capacity manufacturing for nicotine, caffeine, and nootropic
pouches.

What formulations for nootropic pouches do you offer?

We offer a wide range of **custom nootropic formulations**, including:

– Focus blends
– Energy blends
– Calm/relaxation formulas
– Memory & cognitive performance blends
– Mushroom extract blends (lion’s mane, cordyceps, chaga)
– Adaptogen blends
 

We can also develop **fully custom formulations** based on your target effect profile.

Are your product legal in EU?

Yes. Our nicotine alternatives, caffeine pouches, and nootropic pouches can be formulated to meet
**EU regulations**, including rules for non-tobacco oral products. We also support compliance
documentation.

Are your products legal in the U.S?

We manufacture both **US** & **EU-compliant formulations** and **international versions**, depending
on your target market. Regulations vary by country, and we help guide you through the compliance
process.

Whats your MOQ?

Our MOQ starts from 2,500 cans in China, and 5040 cans in Sweden. Depending on the formulation,
pouch format, and packaging requirements. We also offer pilot runs for new brands.

How can i manufacture nicotine pouches?

We provide **complete contract manufacturing**, including formulation, flavor development, pouch
production, filling, packaging, and quality control. You only need your brand concept—our team
handles the rest.

What kind of Caffeine pouches do you offer?

We offer custom **energy pouches**, including caffeine-only, caffeine + taurine, natural energy
blends, B-vitamin blends, and green tea/guarana–based formulas. Strengths and flavors are fully
customizable.

What is your production capacity per month?

Our factory can manufacture 50 million per month in China, and 5 million per month in Sweden.
Depending on product type. We scale production based on your growth and long-term forecasting.

How much does your products costs?

Pricing depends on formulation, active ingredients, pouch type, packaging, and order size. We
provide transparent, competitive quotes tailored to your brand’s specifications.

Can i make custom strength for nicotine pouches?

Yes — we offer **fully customizable strengths**, including nicotine, synthetic nicotine, 6-methyl
analog, caffeine, or nootropics. You can choose strengths tailored to your market and regulatory
needs.

Empowering agriculture through strong collaborations with farmers, Plant Lipids oversees sustainable
contract farming across geo-targeted locations. We support farmers across 20,000 acres with farming
education and employ precision agriculture through farm-level monitoring.

### Speciality Extracts

Revolutionizing flavour and aroma enhancement, our Speciality Extracts division utilizes
cutting-edge technologies like Spinning Cone and Super Critical Fluid Extractions. We’re
transforming food processing with pure and green extraction methods.

### Research and Educational Collaborations

We actively collaborate with esteemed research universities and institutions, fostering dynamic
partnerships to propel advancements in knowledge and technology. We also collaborate with
educational institutions, providing practical experiences, and industry insights, and support
internships and skill development for both students and professionals.

state-of-the-art technology, ensuring streamlined processes from pilot to commercial production.

through groundbreaking solutions.

OUR STORY

PureBulk was founded in 2008 by Timothy McNulty in Missoula, Montana, beginning with a simple idea:
to provide customers with high-quality dietary supplements without the unnecessary fillers, all at
an affordable price. The company’s journey started on eBay, where it quickly gained traction among
health-conscious consumers.

In 2009, PureBulk moved to Oregon to accommodate its growing demand, but the company soon outgrew
its new location. By 2010, PureBulk found its permanent home in Roseburg, Oregon, where it continues
to thrive. Today, the company proudly employs over 40 people in the stunning Pacific Northwest,
committed to delivering pure, transparent products to customers nationwide.

RYZE FAQs

## Frequently Asked

## Questions
* ### How much caffeine is in the product?
  
  A cup of our mushroom coffee medium roast contains about 48mg of caffeine, less than half the
  amount that’s in a regular cup of coffee. To sustain energy naturally and get rid of the jitters,
  we look to Cordyceps, not caffeine. A cup of mushroom coffee dark roast has 80-90mg of caffeine
  per serving which is comparable to a traditional cup of coffee. It delivers a bold coffee
  experience, with whole-body benefits.
* ### Are there any additives or sweeteners?
  
  Absolutely none.
* ### Can you consume while pregnant or breastfeeding?
  
  While it is perfectly safe to consume our product during pregnancy or while breastfeeding, we
  always recommend consulting with your physician before repeated use. 
* ### When is the best time to consume Ryze?
  
  We may be biased because we like to drink RYZE all day long. However, we recommend it first thing
  in the morning to get your energy levels up, your focus turned ON, and your happiness at an all
  time high. It's the perfect way to start the day. It also works amazing as an
  afternoon-pick-me-up. Not at all harsh like coffee, its calm energy takes you smoothly right into
  the evening hours.
* ### Does mushroom coffee contain coffee?
  
  Yes! Our shade-grown, organic arabica coffee is grown in Mexico. After carefully roasting and
  brewing the beans, our coffee is spray-dried into a pure instant powder before being added to our
  formula. It yields just 48mg of caffeine per cup of medium roast, and 80-90mg per cup of dark
  roast.
* ### Where do you ship?
  
  We currently ship domestically in the US only. We are working on expanding our shipping options as
  soon as possible to offer RYZE to mushroom coffee fans worldwide.
* ### Where is it made?
  
  Our company is based in Boston, MA, but our organic mushrooms are sustainably grown in California
  and Nevada. The other ingredients are sourced from the best suppliers in the country, being
  thoroughly tested for mycotoxins and heavy metals. We ship from our warehouse in Texas straight to
  your front door.
* ### What are the differences between mushroom coffee and regular coffee?
  
  Benefits. Benefits. Benefits. With less than half the amount of caffeine in normal coffee,
  mushroom coffee offers a plethora of health benefits like calmer, sharper focus, no jitters,
  sustained energy without the crash, immune support, gut health and a calm digestive tract. In
  addition, functional mushrooms offer benefits to optimize body and brain function due to them
  being antioxidants, anti-virals, and anti-microbials.
* ### Are functional mushrooms the same as magic mushrooms? Will they make me trip?
  
  While we think the mushrooms in our blend are perfectly magical due to their health benefits, no
  they are not psychedelic or magic mushrooms and they will not make you trip. With over 10,000
  species of mushrooms out there, medicinal (or functional mushrooms) are distinct from magic and
  have absolutely no psychedelic effects whatsoever.
* ### Are you certified gluten-free? Vegan?
  
  We are currently working on getting certified gluten free and vegan but we can absolutely assure
  you that all of our ingredients are gluten free and vegan.
* ### Are you organic?
  
  Our mushroom blend and our fiber blend are 100% organic.
* ### How should I use it?
  
  RYZE is a ready to drink beverage. Stir it into 8-10 oz. of hot water or use a mini-frother to
  make it extra foamy and frothy! Nut and non-dairy milks blend very nicely for an even creamier
  texture. Add natural sweeteners to taste.

  brewing the beans, our coffee is spray-dried into a pure instant powder before being added to our
  formula. It yields just 48mg of caffeine per cup of medium roast, and 80-90mg per cup of dark
  roast.
* ### Where do you ship?
  
  We currently ship domestically in the US only. We are working on expanding our shipping options as
  soon as possible to offer RYZE to mushroom coffee fans worldwide.
* ### Where is it made?
  
  Our company is based in Boston, MA, but our organic mushrooms are sustainably grown in California
  and Nevada. The other ingredients are sourced from the best suppliers in the country, being
  thoroughly tested for mycotoxins and heavy metals. We ship from our warehouse in Texas straight to
  your front door.
* ### What are the differences between mushroom coffee and regular coffee?
  
  Benefits. Benefits. Benefits. With less than half the amount of caffeine in normal coffee,
  mushroom coffee offers a plethora of health benefits like calmer, sharper focus, no jitters,
  sustained energy without the crash, immune support, gut health and a calm digestive tract. In
  addition, functional mushrooms offer benefits to optimize body and brain function due to them
  being antioxidants, anti-virals, and anti-microbials.
* ### Are functional mushrooms the same as magic mushrooms? Will they make me trip?
  
  While we think the mushrooms in our blend are perfectly magical due to their health benefits, no
  they are not psychedelic or magic mushrooms and they will not make you trip. With over 10,000
  species of mushrooms out there, medicinal (or functional mushrooms) are distinct from magic and
  have absolutely no psychedelic effects whatsoever.
* ### Are you certified gluten-free? Vegan?
  
  We are currently working on getting certified gluten free and vegan but we can absolutely assure
  you that all of our ingredients are gluten free and vegan.
* ### Are you organic?
  
  Our mushroom blend and our fiber blend are 100% organic.
* ### How should I use it?
  
  RYZE is a ready to drink beverage. Stir it into 8-10 oz. of hot water or use a mini-frother to
  make it extra foamy and frothy! Nut and non-dairy milks blend very nicely for an even creamier
  texture. Add natural sweeteners to taste.

## Sourced from the Heart of Indonesia.

**This isn't just a tagline — it's our promise.** We source green beans from across the Indonesian
archipelago, a place of *fertile volcanic soil* and rich biodiversity that no other origin can copy.

Every bag tells a story: its origin, its processing, the cultural heritage of its home. By focusing
on *quality and sustainability*, we deliver coffee that embodies the natural beauty of Indonesia.

Origin Traceable Farmer Direct Sustainably Sourced
[Indonesia Specialty Coffee logo]
[Coffee cherries drying on raised patio at Indonesia Specialty Coffee processing facility] Drying
Process Natural Coffee Q-grader supervised

Processing

## From cherry to bean — four signature processes.

Every cup begins with the process. We pair traditional artistry with a deep understanding of
*fermentation science* across **four signature methods** — each one drawing out a distinct
character, every batch graded for the highest standards of quality.

01

### Natural

Bold, fruity notes. Whole cherries sun-dried.

02

### Full-Washed

Clean, bright acidity. Fully fermented & washed.

03

### Honey

Balanced sweetness. Mucilage retained on the bean.

04

### Wet-Hulled (Giling Basah)

Full-bodied, earthy. Indonesia's signature method.

[ Our coffee processing ][68]

Bulk Supply

## Indonesia Green Coffee Beans Supplier — bulk supply, global shipping.

**Looking for a reliable bulk coffee supply?** We provide premium green coffee beans starting from
*10 MT*, with origins drawn from across the Indonesian archipelago.

Choose from **Semi-Wash, Full-Wash, Natural, and Honey** processing. With global shipping and
consistent quality, we deliver wherever your roastery operates.

## The language of specialty coffee.

**In specialty coffee, numbers tell a story.** Every lot is evaluated by *Q Graders* on the SCA
scale — judged across fragrance, flavor, aftertaste, acidity, body, balance, sweetness, and
cleanliness.

80+ Specialty Specialty-grade coffee. 85+ Exceptional Complex, harmonious cup. 90+ Rare
Extraordinary micro-lots.

At **ISC**, we cup every coffee to ensure it meets strict standards. For our partners, the cupping
score isn't just a number — it's a *promise of quality in every cup*.

Full-bodied, earthy. Indonesia's signature method.

anti-inflammatory and antipruritic activities. Fluocinonide is a potent glucocorticoid used

[Sale of the operations in the publicly listed company MedicaNatumin AB (publ)][67]

Our Swedish member firm Wesslau Söderqvist Advokatbyrå has advised MedicaNatumin AB (publ) on the
sale of the entire business operations of the group in which MedicaNatumin has been the parent
company to Humble Group AB (publ), which is another publicly listed company in Sweden. The purchase
price amounted to 118 436 622 SEK and included an obligation for MedicaNatumin AB (publ) to reinvest
113 000 000 SEK in Humble Group AB (publ) by buying shares over the stock market. As the transaction
included the entire business operations of the group in which MedicaNatumin has been the parent
company, the transaction was treated as a public takeover bid according to the Swedish takeover
rules and also included a delisting of MedicaNatumin AB (publ) from Nordic SME Sweden.

### The raison d’être of TELFA is client service.

TELFA member firms can assist with all your cross-border and multijurisdictional needs for legal
advice and coordination.

[Read more][58]

### Providing the international legal services you require.

Within TELFA you will only find law firms familiar with handling cross-border and
multi-jurisdictional work. You will get consistent and expert assistance across Europe, and America
through our affiliation with USLAW.

[Read more][59]

## Recent Transactions

[Sale of the operations in the publicly listed company MedicaNatumin AB (publ)][67]

Our Swedish member firm Wesslau Söderqvist Advokatbyrå has advised MedicaNatumin AB (publ) on the
sale of the entire business operations of the group in which MedicaNatumin has been the parent
company to Humble Group AB (publ), which is another publicly listed company in Sweden. The purchase
price amounted to 118 436 622 SEK and included an obligation for MedicaNatumin AB (publ) to reinvest
113 000 000 SEK in Humble Group AB (publ) by buying shares over the stock market. As the transaction
included the entire business operations of the group in which MedicaNatumin has been the parent
company, the transaction was treated as a public takeover bid according to the Swedish takeover
rules and also included a delisting of MedicaNatumin AB (publ) from Nordic SME Sweden.

[Advice on the investment of Inter IKEA Group in Denmark][68]

Our Danish member firm Lund Elmer Sandager has advised Inter IKEA Group on the investment in Flow
Loop

[Sale of the French football team Olympique Lyonnais][69]

Our French member firm has advised the familyholding company of Jean-Michel
Aulas on the sale of the Olympique Lyonnais to Eagle FootballHoldings
LLC, controlled by John Textor. Value: 600M€

[Private equity investments in industrial companies][70]

Our Dutch member firm has advised a Dutch private equity firm which invests in industrial companies,
mainly automotive, power industries and brewery.

## Our Network

TELFA is the only network of law firms to cover the whole of Europe with such a high level of
quality.

[Read more][71]

After becoming an obnoxious health nerd, I found myself spending hours comparing the ingredients of
food and supplement brands. I realized I should share my comparisons to save people time, and built
this fairly boring site.

Each page has my suggestions for which brands I'd choose if consuming the product over the long
term, with an eye towards avoiding unnecessary additives, heavy metals, and [porcine brain
tissue][5].

In spite of trying to look professional by putting on a tie, I don't have any formal education in
health or medicine. The only time you should take my advice seriously is when I'm explaining why
[this][6] is the best video on YouTube.

The Challenge

## The agri-food industry runs on opacity and manual effort.

01

### Information Asymmetry

Buyers and suppliers operate with wildly different levels of market visibility. Pricing,
availability, and quality data are fragmented, outdated, or locked behind intermediaries.

02

### Trust & Verification Gap

Finding reliable counterparties requires years of relationship-building, trade shows, and manual due
diligence. Verification is slow, expensive, and often unreliable.

03

### Execution Bottleneck

Even when opportunities are identified, execution remains manual -- outreach, negotiation, logistics
coordination, compliance, and follow-ups consume enormous time and resources.

OUR VISION

## Agri-food trade should work for everyone in it.

We believe that transparent data, verified networks, and intelligent automation can eliminate the
friction that holds global food trade back. Every buyer deserves fair prices. Every supplier
deserves market access. Every transaction should be efficient.

Data LayerNetwork LayerAI Layer

Together, these three layers form the foundation for a fundamentally better way to trade food
globally.

# Wellaray Coffee Booster Reviews OFFICIAL WEBSITE Is It Worth Buying?

## **Introduction**

The weight management supplement industry continues to expand as more people search for convenient
ways to support healthy weight loss without following restrictive diets or spending countless hours
exercising. Among the products gaining attention is **Wellaray Coffee Booster**, a coffee-based
dietary supplement that claims to enhance metabolism, improve energy levels, support fat burning,
and assist with appetite control.

With so many weight management products entering the market every year, consumers naturally ask an
important question:

**Is Wellaray Coffee Booster actually worth buying?**

This comprehensive review examines the product from an educational perspective by exploring its
ingredient profile, advertised claims, available information, potential benefits, limitations, and
factors every buyer should understand before making a purchasing decision.

Rather than relying on promotional language alone, we’ll take a closer look at what science says
about the individual ingredients while discussing why ingredient research does not automatically
guarantee that a finished supplement will produce the same results for every person.

[**Claim Here with OFFICIAL WEBSITE**][2]

## **What Is Wellaray Coffee Booster?**

Wellaray Coffee Booster is marketed as a dietary supplement designed to be mixed with coffee or
other beverages. According to promotional materials, it aims to support multiple aspects of weight
management through a blend of botanical extracts, dietary fibers, vitamins, minerals, and
metabolism-supporting compounds.

The product is promoted as helping users by:
* Supporting metabolism
* Increasing daily energy
* Helping reduce cravings
* Supporting healthy digestion
* Assisting blood sugar balance
* Promoting healthy weight management
* Complementing an active lifestyle

Like many modern nutritional supplements, Wellaray Coffee Booster combines several ingredients that
have individually been researched for their nutritional properties.

However, an important distinction should always be made between studies on individual ingredients
and clinical studies performed on the finished product itself.

### **Why Products Like Wellaray Coffee Have Become Popular**

Modern lifestyles often make maintaining a healthy weight challenging.

Many adults struggle with:
* Busy schedules
* Sedentary jobs
* Poor sleep
* High stress
* Emotional eating
* Sugary beverages
* Limited exercise

As a result, many consumers look for convenient supplements that can fit into their existing
routines.

Coffee-based supplements have become especially popular because millions of people already drink
coffee daily, making it easier to incorporate an additional product into their morning habits.

### **Understanding the Ingredient Blend**

One of the most important aspects of evaluating any supplement is examining its ingredient list.

[**Wellaray Coffee Booster**][3] contains several recognizable nutritional ingredients.

Let’s review each one individually.

## L-Carnitine

L-Carnitine is an amino acid derivative naturally produced by the body.

Its primary role is transporting fatty acids into cells where they can be converted into energy.

## Embed components

Spend your time building your business, not complex components. Our APIs unlock it all.

CheckoutWalletChat
checkout.tsx
$ npm install @whop/checkout

`import { WhopCheckoutEmbed } from "@whop/checkout/react";

export default function Checkout() {
  return (
    <WhopCheckoutEmbed
      planId="plan_XXXXXXXXX"
      theme="light"
      skipRedirect
      onComplete={(planId, receiptId) => {
        console.log("Payment complete!", { planId, receiptId });
      }}
    />
  );
}`
